mapper.sql: select ttaskout.id, ttaskout.out_delivery_id, ttaskout.out_delivery_detail_id, ttaskout.material_id, ttaskout.predict_count, ttaskout.actual_count, ttaskout.status, ttaskout.stock_id, ttaskout.remark, ttaskout.create_by, ttaskout.create_time, ttaskout.update_by, ttaskout.update_time, ttaskout.dept_id, ttaskout.dept_name, ttaskout.del_flag from t_task_out ttaskout
mapper.select: SELECT e.batch_code batchCode, b.predict_count predictCount FROM t_task_wcs a JOIN t_task_out b ON a.id = b.wcs_id AND b.STATUS = 0 JOIN t_out_delivery_detail d ON b.out_delivery_detail_id = d.id AND d.next_flag = 1 join t_stock e on b.stock_id = e.id WHERE a.task_status = 1 AND a.task_type = 2 AND a.tray_id = #{trayId}

SELECT c.id material_id, c.`code` material_code, c.`name` material_name, b.predict_count, d.small_predict_count, e.count, g.`name` unit_name, b.tray_id, b.location_id, i.batch_code FROM t_task_out b JOIN t_out_delivery_detail d ON b.out_delivery_detail_id = d.id AND d.next_flag = 1 JOIN t_material c ON b.material_id = c.id LEFT JOIN t_unit_config e ON c.id = e.id LEFT JOIN t_unit f ON e.min_unit_id = f.id JOIN t_unit g ON c.unit_id = g.id left JOIN t_material_detail h ON c.id = h.material_id JOIN t_stock i ON h.material_id = i.material_id AND b.tray_id = i.tray_id WHERE b.`status` in (0,1) and b.tray_id = #{trayId} and h.rfid = #{rfid}

SELECT a.id stockid, b.id, b.`code`, b.tray_category, a.available_count, c.`name` locationname, d.`name` areaname, a.location_id,d.id area_id, e.id reservoirid,e.name reservoirname, c.location_type, a.material_id, a.batch_code FROM t_stock a left JOIN t_tray b ON a.tray_id = b.id and b.del_flag = 0 JOIN t_location c ON a.location_id = c.id and c.goods_allocation_status = 2 and c.status = 1 JOIN t_area d ON a.area_id = d.id and d.status = 0 join t_reservoir e on c.reservoir_id = e.id WHERE a.material_id = #{materialId} and a.`status` = 0 and a.is_freeze = 0 and a.del_flag = 0 and b.`code` like "%" #{code} "%" and b.tray_category = #{trayCategory} and c.location_type=#{locationType} ORDER BY ${remark}

mapper.select: select ifnull(sum(before_count - current_count),0) from t_stock_detail where del_flag = '0' and type = '2' and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m-%d') = date_format(now(),'%Y-%m-%d')

select ifnull(sum((t1.before_count-t1.current_count) * t2.unit_price),0) from t_stock_detail t1 left join t_material t2 on t1.material_id = t2.id where t1.del_flag = '0' and t1.type = '2' and date_format(t1.create_time, '%Y-%m') = date_format(now(), '%Y-%m')

select ifnull(sum((t1.before_count-t1.current_count) * t2.unit_price), 0) as outAmount, ifnull(sum(t1.before_count-t1.current_count),0) as outActualCount, t2.id as materialId, t2.name as materialName from t_stock_detail t1 left join t_material t2 on t1.material_id = t2.id where t1.del_flag = '0' and t1.type = '2' and t2.important_status = '1' and date_format(t1.create_time, '%Y-%m') = date_format(now(), '%Y-%m') group by t2.id,t2.name
